name: content-desk.capabilities-read
purpose: Read the marketing capability catalog once and report readiness gaps, limitations and next actions; a requested capability that is absent is reported as absent, never as an empty board.

medium.description: Optional medium filter applied to the whole-board read; omitted means every medium.

capability.description: Optional capability id or alias to resolve in addition to the board. An unresolved value is reported as focus_found=false.

assumptions: Content Desk CapabilitiesService is the team's single declared address for capability definition, readiness and priority state.
A readiness dimension is only as strong as its source; the caller reads readiness_limitations and never treats a limited dimension as verified.
A missing qualification is the explicit unknown sentinel, not a zero or a healthy state.
invariants: No writes: every declared binding has effect read.
At most 80 capabilities are materialized; a larger catalog sets partial and says so.
A requested capability that does not exist is reported as focus_found=false with status ok, never as an empty board.
readiness_limitations and the unknown qualification sentinel are copied verbatim from the owner response; they are never recomputed.
The envelope is printed exactly once, on every path.

bindings.note: Only called when the caller requests a focus; the whole-board read still succeeds without it.

status.note: refused is unreachable: both bindings are read-only and run-eligible, so governance never withholds them.

signals.total: Capabilities the board reported after the medium filter.
signals.materialized: Capabilities included in this envelope; capped at 80.
signals.truncated: True when the catalog exceeded the materialize cap.
signals.readiness: Counts per readiness dimension value for definition, implementation, operational, output and distribution.
signals.unknown_qualification: Capabilities whose latest qualification is absent (unknown sentinel).
signals.with_limitations: Capabilities carrying one or more readiness_limitations.
signals.next_actions: Bounded deduplicated sample of next_action strings.
signals.focus_found: True when the requested capability resolved; false when it did not; null when no focus was requested.
signals.focus: Resolved capability summary when a focus was requested, else null.

outputs.evidence: Capability ids and the binding id read for this run.

fixtures.note: Partial only when the catalog exceeds the materialize cap.
A canonical catalog alias resolves through GetCapability to a live capability.
An unresolved focus is a reported absence, never an empty board or a failed read.
The closed medium set is rejected before source execution.
